description: §39.2 — `CREATE TABLE assets (LIKE tmpl INCLUDING ALL)` in a `<schema>`: the column list is a template reference whose columns (here a `tenant_id`) the database copies but the floors cannot read, so the table would be silently not tenant-scoped. Fail closed: E-SCHEMA-014.
rationale: §39.2: inside a CREATE TABLE column list, an unquoted `LIKE <name>` followed by `INCLUDING`, `EXCLUDING`, `,` or `)` is a template reference, and a head whose column list holds one SHALL be a compile error (E-SCHEMA-014). Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "stamp all" (ii).
